result.summary: The page is mostly polished, but a few elements look visually clipped or crowded, especially horizontally scrollable content and content near the fixed bottom navigation.

issues.description: The lower restaurant card is partially obscured by the fixed bottom navigation bar. The pizza image continues underneath the nav area, making the content feel cut off.
issues.suggestion: Add sufficient bottom padding or safe-area spacing to the scrollable content so cards are not hidden behind the bottom navigation.

issues.description: Several horizontally scrollable items are visibly cut off at the right edge, including the category chip after “Healthy” and the third restaurant card in “Fastest near you.” This may be intentional, but it looks abrupt without a fade, spacing, or clearer carousel affordance.
issues.suggestion: Add right-side padding, a subtle fade, or adjust card widths so the partial-item preview feels intentional rather than clipped.

issues.description: The “Fastest near you” row shows two identical “Green Bowl Poké” cards side by side with the same image, time, and delivery price, which looks like accidental duplication.
issues.suggestion: Verify the feed data and avoid showing duplicate restaurant cards unless intentionally repeated for a reason.
